_comment: English strings for the gameplay keys. A list is a pool: the game picks one by seed, never the same line twice in a row. {name} is filled in. All texts are placeholders (TODO(initiator)). #131 turns this into checked localisation tables.

job.courier_lint_trap.brief: One wobbly parcel to the Lint Trap, just down the path.
job.courier_noodle_post.title: Noodles by hand
job.courier_noodle_post.brief: Two wobbly parcels to the Noodle Post. They are warm. Do not ask why.

job.courier_pebble_kiosk.brief: Three wobbly parcels to the Pebble Kiosk before the timer wins.
briefing.reason.commodity.parcel: The parcel is wobbly. Do not shake it, do not stir it.
Wobbly parcels hate being late and being dropped, in that order.
Nobody knows what is in it. That is the charm.
commodity.sock_dust.name: sock dust
commodity.grumble_jelly.name: grumble jelly
location.slosh_wholesale.name: Slosh & Daughter Wholesale
track.standing_wholesaler.name: standing with Slosh & Daughter
job.customer_order.title: A customer's order
job.customer_order.brief: Goods from the wholesaler for a customer who is waiting.
giver.wholesaler.name: Slosh & Daughter Wholesale
giver.wholesaler.greet.first: Wholesale, retail, and everything in between. Mostly in between.
New? Everything on the shelf is legal. Technically.
Hello! Please do not feed the jelly.
giver.wholesaler.greet.regular: The usual? We have a usual for you.
Back again. The jelly missed you.
Good timing: the sock dust is fresh.
giver.wholesaler.greet.failure: We heard about the last order. The jelly heard too.
A customer called. Several times. Loudly.
Let us make this one go better. For the jelly's sake.
giver.wholesaler.intro: Orders are up on the board.
giver.wholesaler.reason: It is on the house. The house disagrees.
giver.wholesaler.signoff: Bring the empties back. Do not bring the empties back.
customer.mabel_snood.name: Mabel Snood
customer.mabel_snood.order: Mabel Snood: my socks are out of dust again.
Mabel Snood says the dust is for a very serious project.
Mabel Snood wants dust. Do not ask for what.
customer.mabel_snood.thanks: Mabel Snood sniffs the dust and smiles.
Mabel Snood: you may come again.
Mabel Snood adds you to the good list.
customer.mabel_snood.grumble: Mabel Snood: this dust has been stepped on.
Mabel Snood writes you on the other list.
Mabel Snood sighs in four languages.
customer.captain_pip.name: Captain Pip
customer.captain_pip.order: Captain Pip: the jelly crew is restless.
Captain Pip needs jelly before the tide of nonsense turns.
Captain Pip: jelly, and none of your excuses.
customer.captain_pip.thanks: Captain Pip salutes with the wrong hand. High praise.
Captain Pip: shipshape, in a way.
Captain Pip names a puddle after you.
customer.captain_pip.grumble: Captain Pip: the jelly is mutinying.
Captain Pip points at the horizon, meaningfully.
Captain Pip will be telling the harbour about this.
customer.moss_committee.name: The Moss Committee
customer.moss_committee.order: The Moss Committee demands mud, in triplicate.
The Moss Committee has voted for more mud.
The Moss Committee: mud, and the minutes will show it.
customer.moss_committee.thanks: The Moss Committee approves, unanimously, twice.
The Moss Committee moves to thank you. Seconded.
customer.moss_committee.grumble: The Moss Committee notes your failure in the minutes.
The Moss Committee is disappointed, formally.
The Moss Committee will table this. Loudly.
customer.aunt_brisket.name: Aunt Brisket
customer.aunt_brisket.order: Aunt Brisket wants something giggly for the fête. Do not ask.
Aunt Brisket: the loud ones, please, the neighbours are asleep.
Aunt Brisket is hosting again and needs you to be funny about it.
customer.aunt_brisket.thanks: Aunt Brisket pinches your cheek and calls you a good egg.
Aunt Brisket: this will do nicely, dear.
Aunt Brisket hums the whole way out the door.
customer.aunt_brisket.grumble: Aunt Brisket: it burps at the wrong moments. I am disappointed, dear.
Aunt Brisket hands it back to you, slightly sticky.
Aunt Brisket: the neighbours will hear about this.
customer.aunt_brisket.counter_yes: Aunt Brisket: a little extra for a good cause? Fine. Fine.
Aunt Brisket: you drive a hard bargain, dear. Here.
Aunt Brisket says yes and then asks for a receipt.
customer.aunt_brisket.counter_no: Aunt Brisket: no, dear. The price is the price.
Aunt Brisket: I have a sister who sells it cheaper.
Aunt Brisket: we will say no and never mention it.
customer.dr_fennel_obbs.name: Dr. Fennel Obbs
customer.dr_fennel_obbs.order: Dr. Fennel Obbs requires two floaty tonics, one tingle and a glow.
Dr. Fennel Obbs: the study needs a mix with two of the three.
Dr. Fennel Obbs has a theory. The theory needs crates.
customer.dr_fennel_obbs.thanks: Dr. Fennel Obbs: the results are promising. Promising!
Dr. Fennel Obbs writes a note on a napkin. It says thanks, probably.
Dr. Fennel Obbs: a clean sample. My colleagues will be jealous.
customer.dr_fennel_obbs.grumble: Dr. Fennel Obbs: the controls were not controlled by this.
Dr. Fennel Obbs: the samples are on the floor, sadly.
Dr. Fennel Obbs writes you up in the journal of complaints.
customer.dr_fennel_obbs.counter_yes: Dr. Fennel Obbs: the study has a budget for this. Barely.
Dr. Fennel Obbs: fine, the grant will cover it.
Dr. Fennel Obbs: an increase, noted, approved, signed.
customer.dr_fennel_obbs.counter_no: Dr. Fennel Obbs: the grant does not stretch that far.
Dr. Fennel Obbs: we shall use the cheaper sample instead.
Dr. Fennel Obbs: request denied, with a small diagram.
customer.the_sleepy_guild.name: The Sleepy Guild
customer.the_sleepy_guild.order: The Sleepy Guild wants one sleepy crate. Wake them for it.
The Sleepy Guild: send the sleepy stuff, slowly, as is our way.
The Sleepy Guild has been napping since the last delivery. Send more.
customer.the_sleepy_guild.thanks: The Sleepy Guild yawns a thank you that lasts a while.
The Sleepy Guild: good stuff. Wake us when it is next.
customer.the_sleepy_guild.grumble: The Sleepy Guild woke up for this. They are not happy.
The Sleepy Guild: this one kept us awake. Bad.
The Sleepy Guild has written a complaint, eventually.
customer.the_sleepy_guild.counter_yes: The Sleepy Guild: sure, a bit more. Wake us when it is paid.
The Sleepy Guild: yes, if you do not mind waiting for the nap.
The Sleepy Guild agrees, slowly, in a drawn-out way.
customer.the_sleepy_guild.counter_no: The Sleepy Guild: no. Come back after the nap.
The Sleepy Guild: the price is asleep. Leave it.
The Sleepy Guild is not interested. They are dreaming about it.
customer.grandpa_wibble.name: Grandpa Wibble
customer.grandpa_wibble.order: Grandpa Wibble: two of the see-through ones, and do not look at my teeth.
Grandpa Wibble wants to see through things. Mostly his lunch.
Grandpa Wibble: the x-ray stuff, two crates, and a receipt for my wife.
customer.grandpa_wibble.thanks: Grandpa Wibble: I can see right through you, and you are good.
Grandpa Wibble: now I see the bottom of the jar. Thank you.
Grandpa Wibble thanks you with an x-ray wink.
customer.grandpa_wibble.grumble: Grandpa Wibble: I can see right through this, and it is rubbish.
Grandpa Wibble: the see-through stuff was not see-through enough.
Grandpa Wibble: I will tell the whole retirement home.
customer.grandpa_wibble.counter_yes: Grandpa Wibble: a little more for the eyes? Fine, fine.
Grandpa Wibble: I have seen the future and it costs a bit more.
Grandpa Wibble: yes. I can see the money in your pocket.
customer.grandpa_wibble.counter_no: Grandpa Wibble: I can see you are lying about the price.
Grandpa Wibble: no. My eyes are not that good.
Grandpa Wibble: the price stays. I saw it coming.
customer.quartermaster_glim.name: Quartermaster Glim
customer.quartermaster_glim.order: Quartermaster Glim: sticky fingers and a glow, one crate each, quick.
Quartermaster Glim needs crates, no questions, the port is watching.
Quartermaster Glim: a glowing crate for the back room, please.
customer.quartermaster_glim.thanks: Quartermaster Glim: nobody saw that. Good work.
Quartermaster Glim taps the crate twice. That is a thank you.
Quartermaster Glim: the port thanks you, unofficially.
customer.quartermaster_glim.grumble: Quartermaster Glim: the glow is wrong and the fingers are not sticky.
Quartermaster Glim: this will be on your file. Several files.
Quartermaster Glim: the port remembers. The port always remembers.
customer.quartermaster_glim.counter_yes: Quartermaster Glim: a bit more for the risk, yes. Keep quiet.
Quartermaster Glim: fine, the port will pay the extra. Quietly.
Quartermaster Glim nods once. The price goes up by one nod.
customer.quartermaster_glim.counter_no: Quartermaster Glim: no. Too loud a price for a quiet deal.
Quartermaster Glim: the port says no. Do not argue with the port.
Quartermaster Glim: the price is what it is. Move along.
customer.cousin_nettle.name: Cousin Nettle
customer.cousin_nettle.order: Cousin Nettle: aunt sent me, so you have to serve me. Tingly, please.
Cousin Nettle wants tingly stuff, or the sleepy one, whichever is nearer.
Cousin Nettle is new in town and would like one crate, politely.
customer.cousin_nettle.thanks: Cousin Nettle: aunt was right about you. Thanks, I think.
Cousin Nettle tingles a little and says it is nice.
Cousin Nettle: I will tell aunt you are alright.
customer.cousin_nettle.grumble: Cousin Nettle: aunt said you were good. You are not good.
Cousin Nettle: I am telling aunt. She will be cross.
Cousin Nettle sniffs and looks at the wall, pointedly.
customer.cousin_nettle.counter_yes: Cousin Nettle: fine, the tingle is worth a bit more.
Cousin Nettle: yes, I will pay the extra, for aunt's sake.
Cousin Nettle nods. The extra is in the pocket.
customer.cousin_nettle.counter_no: Cousin Nettle: no way. Aunt would never pay that.
Cousin Nettle: the price is too tingly for me.
Cousin Nettle: I will ask aunt. She will say no too.
notice.order.placed: {customer} has an order. Check the wholesaler.
location.skyhook_school.name: Skyhook Flight School
track.licence_flight.name: flight licence
track.standing_flight_school.name: standing with Skyhook Flight School
licence.flight.name: Flight licence
job.flight_exam.title: Flight licence exam
job.flight_exam.brief: Take off, fly to the Drip Rock pad, land on it gently and set the school's crate down. The ship is lent for the exam.
giver.flight_school.name: Skyhook Flight School
giver.flight_school.greet.first: Want to fly? Everybody wants to fly. Few want to land.
Welcome to Skyhook. Our motto: up is optional, down is mandatory.
A new pilot! The ship is lent for the exam. It is the only one we have, so please keep it whole.
giver.flight_school.greet.regular: Licensed and still coming by? We like that.
Back for the honours? Soft hands, soft landing.
giver.flight_school.greet.failure: The ship is fine. Mostly. Let us try again.
Everybody crashes once. Some twice. Half price for the second.
The ground was there the whole time. Remember that.
giver.flight_school.intro: The exam is short, the lesson is long.
Listen carefully, then ignore half of it.
giver.flight_school.reason: Without a licence the seat refuses you. It has opinions.
A licence makes you a pilot, on paper.
The crate is part of the test. It is also fragile.
giver.flight_school.signoff: Up, over, down. In that order.
Mind the ground. It is closer than it looks.
notice.exam.passed: LICENCE PASSED: you may fly. Do not let it go to your head.
EXAM PASSED. The seat now knows you.
PASSED. You are a pilot, officially.
notice.exam.honours: PASSED WITH HONOURS! The school is moved to tears, a little.
HONOURS! A soft landing and a good time. Show-off.
EXAM PASSED, HONOURS. The seat purrs.
notice.exam.failed: Not this time. The retry costs {retry}.
The ground won. Try again for {retry}.
notice.licence.needed: The seat refuses: you need the flight licence. Take the exam at Skyhook Flight School.
No licence, no seat. Skyhook Flight School gives exams.
The seat says no. Ride along, or go and pass the exam at Skyhook.
notice.heat.up: The scanners took an interest. Heat is at {stars} star(s).
Somebody is watching you now. {stars} star(s) of heat.
The wanted board updated. You are at {stars} star(s).
notice.heat.down: Nobody is looking at you quite so hard. {stars} star(s).
The board forgot about you a little. {stars} star(s).
patrol.name: Sergeant Bunting-Nine
patrol.ordered: Halt for inspection! Slow down and keep your hands where we can see them.
Attention, hot crate. Reduce speed now or we start counting.
This is the airspace patrol. Halt for inspection, and do not make us chase you.
patrol.halted: Good. Hold still while the scanner has a nap over your hull.
Thank you for slowing down. The scanner is warming up its nose.
Halted. Nobody panic, the inspection is only a little bit rude.
patrol.fled: You ran. Running is a confession, and the scanner loves confessions.
Speed is not an alibi. The patrol has written down your number.
The chase is on record now. Sergeant Bunting-Nine does not forget a hull.
giver.courier_office.name: Dinglepost Couriers
giver.courier_office.greet.first: New face! We always need a new face. The old ones keep quitting.
Welcome to Dinglepost. The coffee is mud. So is the cargo.
You look employable. That is rare around here.
giver.courier_office.greet.regular: Back again! Management is almost proud.
The reliable one. Our insurance company hates you.
Good to see you. The crates missed you.
giver.courier_office.greet.failure: About last time. We will not talk about last time.
The crates are still crying. Let us do better.
One more chance. Management is counting. Slowly, but counting.
giver.courier_office.intro: Listen closely, I will say this once and then again.
giver.courier_office.reason: The customer is waiting. The customer is always waiting.
It is urgent. Everything is urgent. This one more so.
Do not ask what is inside. It is mostly mud.
giver.courier_office.signoff: Off you go. Walk briskly, not heroically.
giver.small_family.name: The Gribbles
giver.small_family.greet.first: Sit. You have a face we might remember.
Come in, come in. Mind the dog. It is not a dog.
So you are the new one. Aunt Mabel has opinions.
giver.small_family.greet.regular: Again you. Good. The soup is still warm.
giver.small_family.greet.failure: Disappointing. Uncle Bort cried a little.
We spoke about you at dinner. Not kindly.
Careful, now. We have long memories and short tempers.
giver.small_family.intro: It is only a tiny task. Tiny.
giver.small_family.reason: It is a gift. For someone who will not be thanking us.
Do not ask. Aunt Mabel says asking is rude.
giver.small_family.signoff: Go. The soup is getting cold.
briefing.title: {title} for {giver}
{giver} needs: {title}
{title} ({giver})
briefing.shape.few: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}. Not far, not hard.
briefing.shape.many: A big one: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}.
{amount} crates of {commodity} from {from} to {to}. Bring a strong back.
briefing.shape.timed: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}, and the clock is running.
{from} to {to} with {amount} crates of {commodity}. Hurry. The mud is not getting younger.
Quick: {amount} crates of {commodity} from {from} to {to} before the timer wins.
briefing.reason.commodity.fizzy_mud: The mud must stay fizzy, so go easy on the corners.
Fizzy mud goes flat when you rush it. Do not rush it.
briefing.reason.route.dusty: The dust out there makes everyone grumpy, so be early.
Bent Spoon is dusty and impatient.
Dust makes people thirsty and cranky. Deliver before they notice.
briefing.reason.route.wet: Drip Rock is damp and the staff are unhappy about it.
It rains indoors over there. Hurry.
notice.job.accepted: You said yes to {title}. No refunds.
{title} is yours now. Try not to lose it.
notice.job.expired: Too slow: {title} ran out of time.
{title} expired. The mud waits for nobody.
Deadline missed on {title}. The clock has opinions.
notice.job.failed: Nothing arrived for {title}. The customer sighs.
{title} is a loss. A total, complete loss.
Failed: {title}. The customer had other ideas.
notice.reactor.ecool: EMERGENCY COOLING. The pump dumps its coolant on the core. A hiss, a cloud of steam, and it runs cooler for a while.
EMERGENCY COOLING. Everything the tank had, all at once. The cooldown starts now.
notice.reactor.eject: CORE EJECTED. It went out through the bottom, rods and all. The reactor is dead until somebody fits a new core.
CORE EJECTED. Somebody pulled the lever. The core is somewhere under the ship now.
notice.reactor.jump: JUMP. One white flash, the stars smear, and the ship drops out somewhere else. The drive is empty and the systems are cold.
JUMPED. The charge is gone and so is the system you were in. Start the ship up again.
notice.reactor.blast: REACTOR BLAST. The core has left the building, in pieces.
REACTOR BLAST. Whoever was standing near the core is now standing somewhere else.
notice.rods.full: Every slot is full. The reactor is not hungry any more.
No room in the reactor. Pull a rod first, if you dare.
The reactor has all the rods it can hold. Greedy thing.
notice.job.abandon_ask: Really walk away from {title}? Press again.
{title} will be sad. Press again to drop it.
notice.job.abandoned: {title} abandoned. The crates are now decoration.
{title} is no more. Neither are the crates.
Backing out of {title}. The crates have noticed.
notice.job.crate_lost: One crate fewer. It was not insured.
Crate lost. It had a good life.
notice.refused.too_many: Two jobs at a time is plenty.
Your hands are full of jobs.
Finish a job before you hoard another.
notice.refused.not_available: Not yet. Come back when you are someone.
They do not know you well enough.

notice.traffic.out_of_range: Out of range of the tower. Get closer, then hail.
notice.traffic.no_tower: No tower here. Land wherever you like.
tower.grumpy.granted: Pad's yours. Don't make me regret it.
Clearance granted. Try not to bounce off my antenna.
Fine, land. The pad is waiting, unlike my patience.
tower.grumpy.held: Hold position. I am eating a sandwich. Wait.
Holding pattern. The sky is busy with nonsense.
No. Circle. I said circle. Circle until I say otherwise.
tower.grumpy.inspection: Inspection pad. Yes, you. Your crates look suspicious, and so do you.
Go to the inspection pad. Bring your paperwork and your excuses.
Inspection pad, now. Your heat is famous around here.
tower.grumpy.expired: Your window closed. Clearance void. Go away and come back later.
Too slow. Clearance expired. Hail me again, you brave idiot.
Window's shut. The pad has moved on without you.
tower.grumpy.out_of_range: You are not in my airspace. Go away and bother somebody else.
Out of range. I cannot hear you, and frankly I do not want to.
Wrong sky, pal. Come back inside the airspace and hail again.
tower.grumpy.no_tower: There is no tower here. Yes, really. Fly however you like.
No tower in this sky. Nobody is watching, so behave badly.
This is a free port. I have nothing to say. Stop asking.
tower.grumpy.violation.no_clearance: You landed without clearance. A fine, as a treat.
No clearance and you landed anyway. Bold. Expensive, too.
Landing without asking. That is a fine and a frown.
tower.grumpy.violation.wrong_pad: Wrong pad. I gave you a different pad. Read your own screen.
That is not your pad. Fine, and do not do it again.
Wrong pad, genius. The assigned one was right there.
tower.grumpy.violation.speeding: Slow down, you lunatic. Speed limit, look it up.
Too fast in my airspace. Fine. Slow down, please.
Speeding over my sky. That is a fine and a sigh.
tower.grumpy.graded.0: That landing was a crime against gravity.
Rough touchdown. My coffee is spilled. Thanks for that.
That was not a landing. That was a sneeze with wings.
tower.grumpy.graded.1: Survived it. Barely. Stamp issued, self-respect not included.
Bumpy, but you are still in one piece. Stamp of the lowest kind.
tower.grumpy.graded.2: Solid touchdown. Stamp of quality, I suppose.
Nice and easy. Nobody on the pad sneezed.
tower.grumpy.graded.3: Perfect. Do not let it go to your head.
Flawless. I will tell absolutely nobody.
Textbook landing. I hate how good that was.
tower.chirpy.granted: Pad's all yours, friend! Go go go!
Clearance! Wheee, you are cleared to land!
Yes yes yes, land on the pad, sparkle at it!
tower.chirpy.held: Oh, hold tight! Ten laps around the spoon, zoom zoom!
Holding pattern, sweetie! Hold, hold, hold!
Wait wait wait, the pad is busy being a pad!
tower.chirpy.inspection: Inspection pad, buddy! Big scan, big smile!
Go to the inspection pad, shiny one! The scanners are excited!
Inspection! Please wave your crates at the scanner!
tower.chirpy.expired: Oh no! Your window closed, I am so sorry!
Time is up, little ship! Hail me again, pretty please!
Window's gone, the pad is taken, back to the sky!
tower.chirpy.out_of_range: Oopsie, you are too far out! Come closer, sweetheart!
I cannot hear you from out there, come back inside my sky!
Out of range! Fly over the spoon and call again!
tower.chirpy.no_tower: No tower here, what a lovely wild place! Go wherever!
Nobody is up here but the wind. Fly free!
This is a free port, no rules, no tower, weeee!
tower.chirpy.violation.no_clearance: No clearance and you landed! Fine, sorry, sorry!
You landed without asking, oh dear. A fine for the spoon!
Landing without a clearance, naughty! Fine time!
tower.chirpy.violation.wrong_pad: Wrong pad, silly! That was not your pad!
Oops, wrong pad! Fine, but with a kiss on the bumper.
That is not the pad I gave you! Fine, pretty please remember next time.
tower.chirpy.violation.speeding: Too fast, too fast! Slow down, rocket!
Speeding in my sky! Fine, and a wobbly wave.
Whoa, speedy! Slow down, the spoon gets dizzy!
tower.chirpy.graded.0: Ooh, bumpy! Are you okay? Stamp, sadly.
That one went boing. Stamp of the bumpiest kind!
Rough one, buddy! Stamp anyway, hugs.
tower.chirpy.graded.1: Landed! A bit wobbly, but a stamp!
Okay okay, a little wobbly, but I counted it!
Wobbly but yours. Stamp, sticker, the works.
tower.chirpy.graded.2: Ooh smooth! Stamp with a sparkle!
Very nice, a good wiggle-free touchdown!
tower.chirpy.graded.3: Flawless! I am squeaking with joy!
Best landing of the day! Stamp of gold, sparkle included!

lab.discovered: Brand new mix! Written in the recipe book.
Nobody has ever made this before. Noted.
A new recipe, scribbled into the book.
